categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: src/i2p.cpp directly implements I2P SAM integration, which is explicitly covered under p2p network integrations.
categories.rationale: Updates I2P leaseset encryption types to MLKEM-768 and ECIES-X25519 to follow upstream I2P recommendations phasing out legacy ElGamal. This improves cryptographic strength and router interoperability for I2P users, though it is reasonably deferrable maintenance for an overlay network.
